authorization: User explicitly requested P1 immediately after A100 Engineering PASS; this supersedes shutdown immediately after engineering
entry_gate: Verified A100 engineering report must state Engineering PASS and all original probability, direction, stability and checkpoint checks must pass. Never initialize from the engineering probe adapter.
scope: P1 five-arm, one-seed pilot only; no P2 ablations, valid_unseen evaluation or multi-seed efficacy claim
comparison_to_old_p1: A newly registered v3 run, not a direct reproduction: FP32/TF32x3, original-base KL, persistent AdamW and 64-row accumulation come from the validated v3 implementation; historical cold-start predictor data is explicit. Old v2 results and directories remain immutable.
task_order: Original select_games(train, seed=0, iteration, count=16), identical across arms

optimizer.reference: frozen original base via adapter disabling
optimizer.batch_population: all response steps including zero advantage; same denominator and optimizer schedule

initialization: All arms independently start from the original base plus a new zero-initialized LoRA. All verified base-policy round-zero engineering rollouts may be shared as an explicit, hash-verified computational cache because policy, task identities, seeds and frozen sampling configuration are identical. The engineering adapter is never reused.
cold_start: CTHA/progress predictors use the verified original 768 P0 train-only episodes with negative iteration namespace, plus each arm's latest eight train rounds. Historical tokens/logprobs never enter actor updates. Current-policy-only gate results and pooled gate results are both reported. Known historical P0 feasibility is not new independent evidence.
reading: Fixed 12-round budget even if tune threshold is not reached. Report paired task-level uncertainty and train environment steps to 80% tune success, or not reached. This is one development seed, not held-out generalization or a confirmed algorithmic gain. If auxiliary gradients never activate, CTHA was not actually tested.
devices: Independent single-GPU arms, at most two active. Serialize full CPU model loading/merging to avoid host RAM exhaustion. No DDP or tensor parallelism; same logical 64-row gradient accumulation for all arms.
observability: TensorBoard on port 6006; per-arm loss, gradients, k3, clipping, reward/gate/auxiliary activation and tune curves; local JSONL/CSV retained
failure: Stop the affected arm and preserve every record on original parity/stability failure; do not silently tune the learning rate, thresholds, objective, task counts or seeds. Any repair needs a new registered revision and directory.
publication: Register protocol/code on credit-grok before new P1 policy updates; engineering evidence remains distinct. Publish verified P1 reports/data only to credit-grok. Model and optimizer tensors remain local with hashes. No shutdown between engineering and P1.
